_comment_microsoftAuth.value: Entra ID client IDs are intentionally blank in the committed file. Override per environment via `azd env set PoMiniGamesMicrosoftAuthClientId <APP_ID>` (and the same for ApiClientId + TenantId). StartupSecretValidator throws if Production boots with empty values, so a forgotten override fails the deploy rather than silently serving a login wall.

_comment_jevApiKey.value: OpenRouter key for the Jev gate. Override per environment via `azd env set PoMiniGamesJevApiKey <sk-or-v1-...>`. Empty by default is the documented bypass — Jev down = gate falls through to the existing chat call, no behaviour change. Set this for environments where Jev should actually gate calls.
